classify.error: crustdata HTTP 400: 'domains' must be a list — wrap the value in brackets: {"domains": ["neatlogs.com"]}

summary: In [`companyEnrich`](file:///home/ubuntu/tracezeta/src/crustdata.js#L88-L110) within [crustdata.js](file:///home/ubuntu/tracezeta/src/crustdata.js), the payload passed to the Crustdata API endpoint (`POST /company/enrich`) assigned `domain` directly as a bare string (`domains: domain`) rather than an array, causing the API to return HTTP 400 because it requires the field to be a list; this was fixed by wrapping `domain` into an array (`domains: [domain]`) in the request payload.
